description: Docker image that provides a Minecraft Server for Java Edition that automatically installs/upgrades versions, modloaders, modpacks and more at startup

latest_release.body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at ebcf1153a5480df8ce1da19fe9324baf668ac595 -->

## What's Changed
### Enhancements
* Force-include wakes-reforged for Better MC [FORGE] BMC4 by @denizkoekden in https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/pull/4373
* Add USE_MEOWICE_ZGC_FLAGS to use the ZGC version of MeowIce's flags by @spa77k in https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/pull/4382
* pumpkin: Alpine/musl is no longer supported upstream by @itzg in https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/pull/4384
* Force-include SDM UI Lib and GeckolibBetterFPS for CurseForge packs by @Wroud in https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/pull/4385
### Documentation
* example: po3 from local zip file with cleanroom loader by @kman3107 in https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/pull/4366
* build(deps): bump the patches group in /docs with 7 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/pull/4368
* build(deps): bump python-dateutil from 2.9.0.post0 to 3.0.0 in /docs by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/pull/4369
* Update MASH documentation links by @spatterIight in https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/pull/4374
* build(deps): bump the patches group in /docs with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/pull/4376
* Document actual defaults of REMOVE_OLD_MODS_INCLUDE and REMOVE_OLD_MODS_DEPTH by @spa77k in https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/pull/4375
### Other Changes
* Update dependency itzg/mc-image-helper to v1.74.3 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/pull/4365
* build(deps): bump docker/login-action from 4.6.0 to 4.7.0 in the updates group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/pull/4367
* Update dependency itzg/mc-image-helper to v1.74.4 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/pull/4370
* Update dependency itzg/mc-image-helper to v1.75.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/pull/4371
* Split log4j and JVM flags handling out of start-finalExec by @spa77k in https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/pull/4372
* Update dependency itzg/mc-image-helper to v1.76.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/pull/4381
* Update all non-major dependencies by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/pull/4383

## New Contributors
* @spa77k made their first contribution in https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/pull/4372
* @denizkoekden made their first contribution in https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/pull/4373

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/compare/2026.10.1...2026.11.0

[![Docker Pulls](https://img.shields.io/docker/pulls/itzg/minecraft-server.svg?logo=docker)](https://hub.docker.com/r/itzg/minecraft-server/) [![Docker Stars](https://img.shields.io/docker/stars/itzg/minecraft-server.svg?logo=docker)](https://hub.docker.com/r/itzg/minecraft-server/) [![GitHub Issues](https://img.shields.io/github/issues-raw/itzg/docker-minecraft-server.svg)](https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/issues) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/660567679458869252?label=Discord&logo=discord)](https://discord.gg/DXfKpjB) [![Build and Publish](https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/actions/workflows/build.yml) [![](https://img.shields.io/badge/Donate-Buy%20me%20a%20coffee-orange.svg)](https://www.buymeacoffee.com/itzg) [![Documentation Status](https://readthedocs.org/projects/docker-minecraft-server/badge/?version=latest)](https://docker-minecraft-server.readthedocs.io/en/latest/?badge=latest) [![Read the docs](docs/img/banner-docs.png)](https://docker-minecraft-server.readthedocs.io/) There you will find things like - [Quick start with Docker Compose](https://docker-minecraft-server.readthedocs.io/en/latest/#using-docker-compose) - Running [different versions of Minecraft](https://docker-minecraft-server.readthedocs.io/en/latest/versions/minecraft/) and using [various server types](https://docker-minecraft-server.readthedocs.io/en/latest/types-and-platforms/) for Java Edition - [Setting server properties via container environment variables](https://docker-minecraft-server.readthedocs.io/en/latest/configuration/server-properties/) - [Managing mods and plugins with automated downloads and cleanup](https://docker-minecraft-server.readthedocs.io/en/latest/mods-and-plugins/) - [Using various modpack providers/platforms](https://docker-minecraft-server.readthedocs.io/en/latest/types-and-platforms/) - ...and much more There are also many examples located in [the examples directory](examples) of this repo. This image only supports Java edition natively; however, if looking for a server that is compatible with Bedrock edition, then use [itzg/minecraft-bedrock-server](https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-bedrock-server) or [refer to this section](https://docker-minecraft-server.readthedocs.io/en/latest/misc/examples/#bedrock-compatible-server) to add Bedrock compatibility to a Java edition server. [![Sponsors](docs/img/banner-sponsors.png)](#sponsors) SpawnBox - Powered by itzg/minecraft-server, it's a Windows desktop app for parents, teens, and friend groups who want a Minecraft server on their own PC without learning Docker, WSL2, or networking.
Server.pro - A game server hosting platform offering one-click Minecraft server deployment powered by itzg/minecraft-server, with global locations and an easy-to-use control panel.
Seedloaf - Built from scratch (by two nerds) on top of itzg/minecraft-server. Seedloaf offers free, and premium Minecraft servers where you have full control!
[and more...](https://github.com/sponsors/itzg)
